_meta.purpose: Per-language market metrics for plixfy.com (Playgama partner, Arabic base) language-addition decision

confidence_legend.high: Multiple 2024+ sources converge OR direct operator data

_meta.rpm_note: RPMs cited reflect REAL operator-reported numbers where available. These are 3-10x LOWER than agency benchmarks. Display/banner only — rewarded video can be 3-5x higher but requires playable inventory.

top_competitors.name: Poki Arabic (poki.com/ar)
top_competitors.note: Poki serves AR but no dedicated MENA push

languages.competitor_traffic_estimates: Fragmented; no dominant Arabic-first portal at Poki/CrazyGames scale
languages.rpm_note: Zero operator data found 2024+. Gulf CPMs (KSA/AE/KW) higher than Egypt/Maghreb. Triangulated from regional ad-network ranges.
languages.competition_evidence: No DA 80+ Arabic-first portal. Fragmented incumbents. Real opportunity.
languages.tiktok_evidence: MENA TikTok adoption 100M+; gaming creator scene strong
languages.verdict: MAINTAIN - deepen moat; this is the core market

languages.monthly_search_volume_top5_qualitative: high - 'game online', 'game gratis', 'permainan online', 'main game', 'game flash'
languages.competitor_traffic_estimates: Top dedicated id-ID portal is rank #3,350 nationally - BEATABLE
languages.rpm_note: Country AdSense CPM ~$0.12; gaming/entertainment ~$0.20-1.00. One source cited ID YouTube gaming creators at up to Rp 50M (~$3,200)/month (video, not web).
languages.competition_evidence: games.co.id ranks only #3,350; SERP not saturated; thin local incumbents
languages.mobile_evidence: 96% mobile preference (Jakarta Globe 2024); 77% of $1.78B gaming revenue is mobile
languages.tiktok_evidence: 160M TikTok users (#2 globally after US); central to 2025 brainrot meme explosion; Jess No Limit 80M+ followers
languages.translation_note: LLM translation acceptable for UI + game descriptions; native review recommended for marketing copy
languages.cultural_fit_arabic_base: strong - largest Muslim-majority country (87% Muslim); shared values, content sensibilities
languages.verdict: STRONG YES - best 2nd language candidate for plixfy

languages.monthly_search_volume_top5_qualitative: very_high - 'free online games', 'browser games', 'io games', 'play online', 'cool math games'
languages.competitor_traffic_estimates: Fortress. 5+ portals at DR 72-85, 10+ years dominance
languages.rpm_note: OPERATOR DATA: 3M PV/mo gaming site (15% US + EU/JP/CA) = $0.67 page RPM. 1.2M PV unblocked-games UK = $0.95-1.60 RPM. Far below agency $2-8 claims.
languages.competition_evidence: Zero founded-2022+ generic portals broke top 10 in 2024-2025. Aleyda Solis 2026 study: CrazyGames -14%, Poki -39%, Arkadium -68% YoY organic. AI Overviews compress SERP CTR (32.76% presence).
languages.mobile_evidence: Naavik/SimilarWeb: 28% mobile / 72% desktop across top browser-gaming sites. Range 4% Pogo to 52% agame.
languages.tiktok_evidence: Cloutboost 2026: 'TikTok no longer offers same free organic visibility'. Chicken Road case shows funnel works but for emerging markets (22% IN, 18% US, 15% BR)
languages.growth_trajectory: Declining for incumbents; saturated head terms
languages.verdict: SKIP for SEO play. Add ONLY if pursuing TikTok-driven single-game viral strategy.

languages.rpm_note: Tier-2 multiplier: 5-10x lower than Tier-1. India gaming/entertainment AdSense ~$0.50-1 specifically. 90% of new Indian internet users prefer local languages (Hindi).
languages.competition_evidence: Poki already monetizes India as #2-3 traffic source. To capture India properly need Hindi, not English.
languages.tiktok_evidence: TikTok banned in India since 2020; Instagram Reels + YouTube Shorts substitute
languages.verdict: SKIP - Poki already serves; Hindi is the real India play but expensive to localize

languages.monthly_search_volume_top5_qualitative: high - 'oyun', 'oyun oyna', 'ateş ve su' (262K/mo to oyunskor alone), 'kız oyunları', 'araba oyunları'
languages.rpm_note: Turkey country AdSense CPM ~$0.09. YouTube Turkey RPM $0.69 = 91% below US (lira collapse, Dec 2024 inflation 44%). Brutal monetization.
languages.competition_evidence: Multiple DR 50+ incumbents with 4K+ referring domains. Head terms locked.
languages.tiktok_evidence: Active gaming creators but mostly drive to mobile titles, not browser portals
languages.translation_note: Turkish has rich morphology; LLM translation good but native review needed
languages.cultural_fit_arabic_base: strong - secular-Muslim cultural overlap, growing internet, Ottoman-historic ties
languages.growth_trajectory: Heavy studio investment (Scopely/Loom $1B+, CVC/Dream $5B) but PORTAL layer sleepy
languages.verdict: CONDITIONAL YES (3rd or 4th language) - volume play only; brutal RPM economics

languages.rpm_note: AdSense BLOCKED for Iran publishers (OFAC). Persian NOT on AdSense supported languages list. Two independent disqualifiers.
adsense_blocked_reasons: Persian language not on AdSense supported publisher languages list
languages.diaspora_verdict: Too small for dedicated portal; bilingual English speakers anyway
languages.verdict: HARD NO - do not pursue Persian under any plixfy roadmap

top_competitors.name: Poki Spanish
top_competitors.note: Major LATAM presence, country-level not broken out

languages.rpm_note: Spain EU-tier-2 CPMs. LATAM: AR/MX/CO $0.80-3 range. Games-vertical specifically at low end.
languages.competition_evidence: minijuegos + Friv dominate but no DA 85+ Spanish-first portal. Long-tail accessible.
languages.tiktok_evidence: LATAM TikTok strong, especially MX/CO/AR; Spain modest
languages.translation_note: One es locale serves all - minijuegos proves dialect-neutral works for games portals
languages.verdict: DEFER (4th language if pursued at all) - lower priority than Indonesian/English given plixfy constraints

languages.rpm_note: Brazil display CPM $1-4, RPM $0.50-2 realistic. YouTube BR RPM $2.00 reference.
languages.mobile_evidence: Statista 2024: 55.5% mobile / 43.8% desktop. 96.5% access via smartphone.
languages.tiktok_evidence: Brazil top-3 TikTok market; gaming-related TikTok very active
languages.translation_note: pt-BR ≠ pt-PT - need Brazilian Portuguese specifically
languages.myth_bust_verdict: Viable but 3-8x lower RPM than Tier-1. Need 5-8x pageviews of equivalent Spanish/EU portal to match revenue. Volume play only.
languages.verdict: DEFER (5th+ language if ever) - lower ROI than Spanish single-locale for similar effort

languages.competitor_landscape: No dedicated Tagalog HTML5 games portal found. Filipinos consume English portals (Poki, Y8, CrazyGames) directly.
languages.tiktok_evidence: 62.3M TikTok users (80.1% of adults 18+) but gaming funnel mostly to Mobile Legends, not browser portals
languages.verdict: HARD NO - adds zero unlock. Filipinos already use English portals. Add English if you want PH (but see English verdict).

languages.rpm_note: VN country CPM ~$0.10. One unverified claim of $5+ RPM rejected as inconsistent.
languages.competition_evidence: gamevui.vn at 3M monthly - beatable with effort
languages.mobile_evidence: Antom 2024: 86.6% mobile gamers; mobile ARPU $53.8 vs PC $3.6
languages.translation_note: Vietnamese requires fresh localization; no language adjacency to Arabic; tonal language nuances
languages.vietnamese_app_preference: Strong app-over-web preference - reduces portal addressable market

languages.competition_evidence: crazygames.fr leads; jeuxjeux.fr/jeux.fr legacy; no notable founded-2022+ entrants
languages.verdict: SKIP - saturated, no cultural fit advantage

languages.competition_evidence: spielaffe.de still strong (legacy); no founded-2022+ German entrants observed
languages.verdict: SKIP - high RPM but high competition and zero cultural fit

languages.competition_evidence: Thinner SERP than ES/FR/DE; mostly Poki/CrazyGames localized + legacy giochi.it
languages.verdict: SKIP for plixfy specifically (low priority vs ID/EN)

languages.competition_evidence: gry.pl + PacoGames dominate; no fresh 2022+ Polish entrants
languages.verdict: SKIP - smaller market, no cultural fit, better candidates exist
